items.title: Email code sign-in is now for team members
items.body: The email code option no longer sits under Forgot your password, so it is not mistaken for a password reset. Invited team members still see it on their own sign-in screen.

items.title: Organize step matches the rest of the app
items.body: Indoor and Outdoor are now the same tabs you see on Opportunities, selected options use a soft highlight, and the long notes in a package's delivery line are gone.

items.title: Brochure reading now runs on our servers
items.body: When you upload a package brochure, it is now read securely on our servers instead of inside the app, so reading your packages keeps working and nothing sensitive is stored on your phone.

items.title: My packages and New package match Opportunities
items.body: Tabs, step chips, card headers and detail boxes now use the same compact layout as Opportunities, and the long notes that sometimes appeared in a package's delivery line are gone.

items.title: New package now matches the rest of the app
items.body: The New package screen uses the same frosted glass cards, lighter type and softer highlights as your other screens, and reading a brochure photo into packages works again.

items.title: Share and publish the albums you already have
items.body: On Home, Share your album now opens your Albums screen, where you can share or publish any album you have already made, instead of starting a new one.

releases.title: One card to share and invite

items.title: Share and invite in one place
items.body: The Share card on Home now says what is inside: your album, your profile and your referral code. Tap anywhere on the card to open it.

items.title: See your fee at a glance
items.body: The card shows your current platform fee once you reach 5 referrals, and the sheet shows your progress toward the next level.

releases.title: Refer photographers and lower your fee

items.title: Share your referral code
items.body: The Share button on Home now opens a menu with your album, your profile and your personal referral code and link. Photographers you refer who start earning lower your platform fee, down to 10 percent.

items.title: Add a code if someone referred you
items.body: You can enter a referral code at sign-up, or later in Preferences, and see who referred you. It can be set once and the policy explains how it works.

releases.title: A fainter watermark on live video

items.title: The picture comes first
items.body: The Connekyt watermark on live video is now fainter, so it gets out of the way of what you are watching.

releases.title: Chat on live events works when you are signed in

items.title: Your messages are sent
items.body: When you are signed in and watching a live event, the messages you type now reach the chat for everyone. Before, they only showed on your own screen.
